event_rescue.scene: SETTING: the same small patch of sandy dirt ground with a few small grey pebbles as in reference image 3 - a quiet, safe corner. The lower part of one of its front legs, just above the paw (its ankle), is wrapped in a clean white bandage. Qiuqiu kneels on the ground on the RIGHT, facing the village cat, both paws resting on his knees, looking at the two gifts with a surprised, modest face.
